items.title: John Handy Interview, 1958-12-05
items.q: No, I never know Charlie Parker.

ctx.x: Charlie Parker? Mm-hmm. No, I don't think. Uh-uh. Yeah, I just, I just wondered if he was
coming up then in those years. No. Did you ever know him? No, I never know Charlie Parker. Somebody had just mentioned, you know, that he used to listen to you. Somebody told me that, you know.

He might have. He might have, but I, I, I didn't know anything about it because he used to have so many of these guys sit around and stand on the outside. Mm-hmm. They wouldn't show their face. They stand outside, they'd listen. I like, uh, this fellow, Earl Bostic. Mm-hmm. He didn't know him. But Bostic didn't care who seen him listening because he'd come in anywhere I'd be. And wouldn't blow up notes. All the horn he played wouldn't play a thing. But he'd stare. I don't care where I was playing. If he couldn't…
